adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `createEvent(calEventRaw, credentialId)` selects the target calendar correctly via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, but it sets the organizer attendee email using only the first destination calendar: `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = ...` and then `email: mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId ? mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId : calEventRaw.organizer.email`. Since `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now loops over `event.destinationCalendar` and invokes `createEvent` for each destination/credential, any invocation where the matching destination is not index 0 will use the wrong externalId for the organizer attendee email.
